Description: The canonical points to a different page, so this page will not be indexed.
The URL is harder to read or share (uppercase, underscores, encoded characters, IDs, parameters or too long/deep).
Recommended fix: Rename the route/slug (e.g. /blog/my-article), and 301-redirect the old URL to the new one.
